name: Newborn Baby Care
description:
Our Newborn Baby Care service ensures gentle and attentive care for your newborn in the comfort of your home.

Trained caregivers assist with feeding, diaper changing, bathing, and hygiene.

We carefully monitor sleep and comfort to keep your baby safe and calm.

Caregivers provide age-appropriate interaction to support early development.

Strict safety and cleanliness standards are always followed.

With CareConnect, your newborn is always in loving hands.
description_bn:
